description: Defines interfaces and factory functions for Diffie-Hellman key exchange (both asynchronous and synchronous) within the QUIC protocol implementation, including classes for key exchange operations and related callback mechanisms.

classes.name: AsynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface for Diffie-Hellman key exchange with asynchronous capabilities, allowing for private key management and external key exchange services.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Base class for receiving results of asynchronous shared key calculation.

classes.name: SynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface extending AsynchronousKeyExchange for synchronous key exchange operations, holding the private key locally.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeyAsync
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous calculation of shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeySync
methods.description: Performs synchronous calculation of shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: public_value
methods.description: Returns the local public key for key exchange.
